claims.claim_ar: مقابلة بين «لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ» و«وَلَكُمْ مَا كَسَبْتُمْ»، أي توازٍ واصطلاحٌ بياني يجسم التماثل اللفظي والمعنوي بين الطرفين.
claims.claim_en: A muqabalah (paired/parallel structure) between “to them what they earned” and “to you what you earn,” creating formal and semantic symmetry that emphasizes separation of outcomes and personal responsibility.
